msi-structured-release.producer: ClawA1M.ReleaseMsiFanControl; inherited by exact admitted Claw routes
msi-structured-release.required: Producer reads valid blocks, modifies only control bit7, reads back 152 then 212, aggregates result; Host requires current boot plus operation token and consumes Status. Unknown/failed/current-certificate-absent cannot fall back to compat success.
msi-structured-release.closeSemantics: A new Close release is settled against its own token and invocation boundary; newer unknown/failed result cannot retain prior success. No new handback may preserve prior state.

asus-scope-receipts.producer: Existing HC ASUS scope receipts; backend ASUS transport/controller retains per-channel receipts
asus-scope-receipts.hostDispatch: Hardware profile callback; existing HC ACPI fallback only under its actual guard
asus-scope-receipts.required: Current matching operation scope; zero delivered/explicit failure is not success; missing/unknown stays unknown. Existing policy accepts at least one delivered channel as partial release evidence and preserves per-channel failures; partial does not mean all-channel success.
asus-scope-receipts.closeSemantics: Resource close/manager cleanup remains separate. Optional ASUS table readback is not mandatory and is not a firmware ownership ACK.

sourceAnchors.anchor: internal bool ConfirmCandidateCloseCleanup(int timeoutMs, out string detail)

hc-compat-callback.producer: Actual route-specific HC hardware-mode profile/SetFanControl(false) callback, resolved through inheritance
hc-compat-callback.hostConsumption: SettleOperationEvidence -> CompatRouteWithoutScope -> ConfirmOemRestore and final release predicate
hc-compat-callback.required: Only explicitly reviewed CompatCallbackNoScope routes with live prerequisites. No generic ASUS receipt requirement. Callback-not-returned is failed; unmet prerequisites and unsupported/unregistered routes stay unknown.
hc-compat-callback.closeSemantics: Compat callback evidence is distinct from transport success and physical ACK; cleanup cannot create release proof.

notCompletionClaims: Not all current-route runtime receipts are established by this static review.
Four MSI total catalog identities are not four tested physical devices.
Historical 62 checks are ASUS roundtrip, not MSI.
The October 7 ClawA2VM receipt is not an October 18 recovery result.
Missing logged OperationToken cannot be reconstructed from BootIdentity alone.
Source differences or stale receipts alone are not product regressions.
Preferred MSI fan-only policy still requires HC structured transport and release; HC dependency is not replaced by this metadata.
Retained HC full-device/profile alternative has no current MSI UI switch or automatic failover.
CG3EM historical release/Close evidence does not establish current-input execution or physical acceptance for the other MSI models.
